name: Intel 8051 LED Blink
desc: Intel 8051 - Blink an LED on P1.7 using CLR/SETB bit instructions with ACALL delay.
code:
; Intel 8051 - Blink LED on P1.7
; Connect an LED + resistor from P1.7 (pin 8) to GND

        ORG 0000H

LOOP:   CLR P1.7         ; P1.7 = 0 (LED ON, active low)
        ACALL DELAY      ; Wait ~500ms
        SETB P1.7        ; P1.7 = 1 (LED OFF)
        ACALL DELAY      ; Wait ~500ms
        SJMP LOOP        ; Repeat forever

; Delay subroutine using nested DJNZ
DELAY:  MOV R2, #0FFH    ; Outer counter = 255
DL1:    MOV R3, #0FFH    ; Inner counter = 255
DL2:    DJNZ R3, DL2     ; Decrement R3, loop if != 0
        DJNZ R2, DL1     ; Decrement R2, loop if != 0
        RET
        END
